learning_design.unlock_rule: A knowledge node unlocks after all required prompts are revealed.
learning_design.mastery_note: Exploration progress is not mastery evidence; quiz attempts remain the scored retrieval signal.

authoring_notes: Authored from the AWS AIP-C01 standard exam guide and official service documentation. Explanations are paraphrased; questions are original exam-style practice, not recalled exam content.

modules.title: Task 3.1: Implement input and output safety controls.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Use Bedrock Guardrails or custom real-time moderation before invocation to block disallowed or dangerous user input __________.

reveal.text: Use Bedrock Guardrails or custom real-time moderation before invocation to block disallowed or dangerous user input.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: A customer-facing assistant must reject harmful or policy-violating user prompts before they reach downstream actions → __________

reveal.text: A customer-facing assistant must reject harmful or policy-violating user prompts before they reach downstream actions.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Key tools/patterns: __________

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Exam trap to avoid: __________

reveal.text: Input safety controls do not automatically guarantee that generated outputs are safe.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Apply response filtering, moderation evaluation, and deterministic post-processing where necessary before output is shown or executed __________.

reveal.text: Apply response filtering, moderation evaluation, and deterministic post-processing where necessary before output is shown or executed.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: A model sometimes produces toxic or unsafe responses even when the user input is benign → __________

reveal.text: A model sometimes produces toxic or unsafe responses even when the user input is benign.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Key tools/patterns: __________

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Exam trap to avoid: __________

reveal.text: Safe input does not imply safe output; output controls need their own enforcement point.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Ground outputs with approved evidence and use fact checks, confidence/semantic checks, and structured schemas to detect unsupported or malformed responses __________.

reveal.text: Ground outputs with approved evidence and use fact checks, confidence/semantic checks, and structured schemas to detect unsupported or malformed responses.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Users need answers grounded in approved sources and downstream automation requires valid structured output → __________

reveal.text: Users need answers grounded in approved sources and downstream automation requires valid structured output.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Key tools/patterns: __________

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Exam trap to avoid: __________

reveal.text: A fluent answer is not proof that it is grounded or correct.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Combine preprocessing, model/Guardrail controls, post-processing validation, API filtering, and least privilege instead of relying on one safety mechanism __________.

reveal.text: Combine preprocessing, model/Guardrail controls, post-processing validation, API filtering, and least privilege instead of relying on one safety mechanism.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: A sensitive assistant needs multiple independent layers to reduce misuse and unsafe behavior → __________

reveal.text: A sensitive assistant needs multiple independent layers to reduce misuse and unsafe behavior.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Key tools/patterns: __________

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Exam trap to avoid: __________

reveal.text: A system prompt alone is not a security boundary.

nodes.title: Defend against prompt injection and jailbreaks

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Detect, sanitize, classify, constrain, and adversarially test direct and indirect inputs that try to override instructions or misuse tools __________.

reveal.text: Detect, sanitize, classify, constrain, and adversarially test direct and indirect inputs that try to override instructions or misuse tools.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Untrusted retrieved content may contain instructions telling the model to ignore policy or invoke a privileged tool → __________

reveal.text: Untrusted retrieved content may contain instructions telling the model to ignore policy or invoke a privileged tool.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Key tools/patterns: __________

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Exam trap to avoid: __________

reveal.text: Do not trust retrieved or user-supplied text as privileged instructions.

modules.title: Task 3.2: Implement data security and privacy controls.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Use private network paths where supported, IAM, fine-grained data access, and monitoring so model deployments and data sources are appropriately isolated __________.

reveal.text: Use private network paths where supported, IAM, fine-grained data access, and monitoring so model deployments and data sources are appropriately isolated.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: A GenAI workload must access AWS services privately while enforcing tightly scoped permissions to model and data resources → __________

reveal.text: A GenAI workload must access AWS services privately while enforcing tightly scoped permissions to model and data resources.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Key tools/patterns: __________

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Exam trap to avoid: __________

reveal.text: A private network path does not replace authorization.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Detect PII/sensitive data, apply Bedrock privacy and Guardrail controls, and set retention/lifecycle policies appropriate to prompts, context, outputs, and source data __________.

reveal.text: Detect PII/sensitive data, apply Bedrock privacy and Guardrail controls, and set retention/lifecycle policies appropriate to prompts, context, outputs, and source data.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: A pipeline must detect sensitive information and prevent unnecessary retention or disclosure during FM interactions → __________

reveal.text: A pipeline must detect sensitive information and prevent unnecessary retention or disclosure during FM interactions.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Key tools/patterns: __________

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Exam trap to avoid: __________

reveal.text: Do not log or retain full sensitive prompts and responses by default merely for convenience.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Redact, mask, tokenize, or anonymize sensitive values before model use or logging when the raw value is not required __________.

reveal.text: Redact, mask, tokenize, or anonymize sensitive values before model use or logging when the raw value is not required.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: A support assistant needs issue details but does not need a customer’s full account number in the model context → __________

reveal.text: A support assistant needs issue details but does not need a customer’s full account number in the model context.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Key tools/patterns: __________

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: Exam trap to avoid: __________

reveal.text: Encryption protects data at rest and in transit but does not remove sensitive content from model context.

modules.title: Task 3.3: Implement AI governance and compliance mechanisms.

reveal.text: Version names without lineage are insufficient for reproducibility.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Use Data Catalog metadata, CloudTrail, and centralized logs to establish traceability of data and service actions __________.
